claim_text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] is the principal laboratory marker used to assess vitamin D status.
health_goal_or_outcome: Clarify the appropriate biomarker when vitamin D status requires clinical assessment.

population.age_range: General population; interpretation thresholds depend on applicable clinical guidance.
population.other_context: Do not infer deficiency from sun exposure or dietary pattern alone.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Vitamin D status; not a supplement formulation claim.
evidence_summary: The existing NIH ODS Vitamin D Health Professional source is already referenced by the repository's vitamin D deep record and draft rules. Retained as a draft claim pending extraction of the current source text and human review.
limitations: Does not recommend testing for every user.
Does not prescribe supplementation or dose.
